question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

This **case** calls for immediate action.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Legal matter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"case"** has multiple meanings and is a homonym, meaning it can refer to different concepts depending on the context. (प्रकरण या मामला)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** "Case" can mean a legal matter or dispute, an example or instance, a scenario, or even a physical container like a suitcase.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** मामला, केस, उदाहरण, परिदृश्य, या सूटकेस
 
 
 
• **Legal matter** refers to a situation or issue that involves legal action or requires legal attention. (कानूनी मामला)
 
 
• **Example:** The lawyer handled the case with great expertise, ensuring justice was served.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the context of the sentence "This case calls for immediate action," "case" refers to a legal matter, making it the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Legal matter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Suitcase** (सूटकेस): A portable container used for carrying clothes and other personal items during travel.

 
 
• **Example:** She packed her suitcase with all the essentials for her trip.
 
 
 
• **Example** (उदाहरण): A representative instance or model of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher provided an example to clarify the concept of gravity.
 
 
 
• **Scenario** (परिदृश्य): A description or representation of a particular situation or sequence of events.
 
 
• **Example:** The team discussed various scenarios for the upcoming project deadline.
